Listed here are the rewards you can earn by cashing in your Pedometer Steps.
Pedometer steps are gained while equipping the Pedometer and walking through
areas where you can run into enemies. These steps are doubled if you have an
Accelerator equipped.

If you talk to any Silent Peddler after you have 10,000 Steps accumulated, then
you will receive the [_LEATHER SUIT_], Margarete's best armor. (Margarete does
NOT have to be in your active party to receive the armor!)

.———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————.
|                 -$-   Pedometer Service   -$-                 |
|===============================v===============================|
| Thera Extract       -     100 | Moon Swallow        -    3500 |
| Voodoo Doll         -     300 | Star Swallow        -    5000 |
| Weird Bottle        -     800 | Monkey Paw          -    6500 |
| Iron Clogs          -    1500 | Silver Hand         -    7000 |
| Flash Badge         -    2500 | Belt of Power       -    8000 |
|———————————————————————————————'———————————————————————————————|
| Leather Suit        -   10000 (automatic)                     |
